request.deadline: instantly performed as part of the governance action's enactment on-chain
deliverables: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse a 100,000 ADA governance action deposit
Additional 3,000 ADA compensation for claimed lost staking rewards
request.what: Reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action, plus claimed lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: An Info governance action titled "Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai -" was submitted in September 2024 after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai governance action was symbolic and asked whether the community agreed with a statement of thanks and hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering a 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposal requests 103,000 ADA, consisting of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for lost staking rewards at 2% per annum.
The proposer says there was significant community sentiment at the time that the Ikigai deposit should be reimbursed.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included the reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The recipient of the reimbursement has not previously received Cardano treasury funds.
The requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal states that distribution can be audited on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
The referenced AdaStat governance URL is provided as an external source related to the original governance action.

summary: The proposal seeks 103,000 ADA to reimburse a claimed unrecoverable Ikigai Info governance action deposit and estimated lost staking rewards, but most core justifications are asserted rather than evidenced in the document.
